chapter: Second day: early memories, London 1966 and other singers
title: Triumph in London and writing "Woman, Be Wise"
summary: She was scared but drew huge crowds, and wrote "Woman, Be Wise" on the spot when the show wanted new songs.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
